title: Refunds
text: You can request a refund for an unused data pack within 14 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 working days.

title: Double charges
text: If you were charged twice, send us the invoice number. We reverse duplicate charges within 3 working days.

title: Roaming charges
text: Roaming is charged per day while your phone uses a partner network abroad. Turn off data roaming in settings to avoid charges.

title: Bill due date
text: Bills are issued on the 1st of each month and are due by the 20th. Late payment adds a fixed fee.

title: No signal
text: If you have no signal, restart your phone and check the outage map. If there is no outage, reset network settings.

title: Slow mobile data
text: Mobile data can slow down at busy times near stations. If speeds stay low all day, check your monthly data allowance.

title: 5G coverage
text: 5G is available in major city centres. Your phone falls back to 4G where 5G is weak, for example inside some buildings.

title: Dropped calls
text: Calls can drop in tunnels and on trains. Turn on Wi-Fi calling for better indoor coverage.

title: Home router red light
text: A red light on the home router means no connection. Unplug it for 30 seconds, then plug it back in.

title: Password reset
text: Reset your password from the login screen. The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Login problems
text: If you cannot log in after a reset, clear the app cache and use the new password. Accounts lock after five failed attempts for 15 minutes.

title: SIM blocked abroad
text: A SIM can be blocked after unusual activity abroad. Verify your identity in the app or at a store to unblock it the same day.

title: SMS codes
text: If SMS codes do not arrive, check that your number can receive messages and that you are not blocking short codes.

title: Change email
text: Change the email address on your account under Profile, then confirm the new address from the link we send.

title: Family plan
text: A family plan covers up to five lines on one bill. Each extra line gets its own data allowance.

title: Plan upgrade
text: You can upgrade your plan at any time. The new price applies from the next billing cycle.

title: Store hours
text: Most stores open 10:00 to 20:00 every day, including Sundays. Check the store finder for local hours.

title: Data pack not active
text: Data packs activate within 15 minutes. If a pack is not active after an hour, contact support for a refund or a manual activation.

title: Number transfer
text: To keep your number when you join us, request a transfer code from your old provider. The transfer takes up to 2 days.

title: Complaints
text: If support does not solve your issue, ask for a team lead. Formal complaints get a reply within 10 working days.
